ideas.name: flat by 14:30 CT
ideas.why: the last half hour is position squaring and MOC imbalances: late moves reverse

ideas.name: 30 minutes' rest after a stop
ideas.why: a stopped breakout means the market is rotating; the next signal minutes later is the same rotation

ideas.name: hold through an opposite signal (no flip)
ideas.why: an opposite breakout inside a running trade is often a shakeout; the trade's own stop and target know better

ideas.name: out after 30 minutes whatever happens
ideas.why: a breakout's edge is in its first minutes; holding longer is exposure without it

ideas.name: enter at the market on the signal instead of the stop order
ideas.why: the stop order waits for more breakout and misses the fast ones; the signal is the edge

ideas.name: no new entries after 14:00 CT
ideas.why: an hour before the flat there is no time to reach the target; the late trades are cut by the clock
